name: Kettlebell Swing

instructions.description: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip width and hold the kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and guide the kettlebell back between your legs while keeping your spine neutral.
Drive your hips forward powerfully to swing the kettlebell to about chest height without lifting with the arms.
Let the kettlebell fall back under control and repeat with a rhythmic hip hinge pattern.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use crisp, powerful hip extension rather than a squat pattern.
Choose a load that allows safe control of the arc.

variations.variationDescription: Uses a similar hip hinge pattern but adds dynamic power and conditioning demand.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use a slower hinge pattern to learn hip loading before swinging.

commentsNotes: Do not let the kettlebell pull you into spinal flexion.
The arms guide the bell; the hips generate the force.
